messages:
Maya (devex): Heads-up — onboarding team hit a nasty DX bump in the sample app. When the API returns an auth failure the client surfaces `Exception('request failed')` and the webkit sample just shows `Something went wrong` to end users. This makes it hard to triage for new integrators.

Devon (sdk): Ugh. That's the generic catch-all path we still have in the Python SDK when we can't parse the error body. We do extract `status` sometimes but haven't standardized typed exceptions across SDKs.

Maya (devex): Can we define a small typed error contract+mapping so sample apps can show proper messages and automatic retries are safe? Something like: 401 -> AuthError (retry: false, hint: re-auth), 429 -> RateLimitError (retry: true, retry_after if present), 400 -> BadRequest (validation details), 503/502 -> TransientError (retry: true), 5xx -> ServerError (retry: maybe). Also include a stable `request_id` and an encoded `support_link` in the payload.

Sam (platform): We already include `request_id` and `error.code` in most responses but payload shape varies by internal handler. Standardizing would be great — we might need to add a top-level `error.hint` field. Agree on semantics: AuthError should explicitly include `reauthenticate: true/false`.

Devon (sdk): For SDK parity we want: (1) language-idiomatic typed exceptions, (2) machine-readable fields on the exception object like `.code`, `.status`, `.retry_after`, `.request_id`, `.hint`, (3) clear docs and examples. TypeScript example I'd propose: 

```ts
type ApiErrorBase = { status: number; request_id?: string; message: string }
type AuthError = ApiErrorBase & { type: 'auth'; reauthenticate: boolean }
type RateLimitError = ApiErrorBase & { type: 'rate_limit'; retry_after?: number }
export type ApiError = AuthError | RateLimitError | { type: 'bad_request'; details?: any } | { type: 'server'; code?: string }
```

Devon (sdk): And Python: subclass Exception -> ApiError, AuthError, RateLimitError with attrs `status`, `retry_after`, `request_id`.

Alex (eng): Implementation note: runtime sometimes returns HTML for 500s from edge LB. If SDKs expect JSON they choke. We should ensure platform returns JSON error envelope even for LB/503. I'll add a middleware to normalize non-json responses to `{"error": {"message": "internal"}, "request_id": "..."}`.

Maya (devex): That middleware is key — onboarding sample app should never see a raw HTML body. Also we should update the Quickstart to show how to catch typed errors and render friendly UI. Example snippet for React: 

```jsx
try { await client.generate(...) } catch (err) {
  if (err.type === 'auth') { showLoginModal() }
  else if (err.type === 'rate_limit') { showBanner(`Try again in ${err.retry_after || 'a few'}s`) }
  else showBanner('Something went wrong — contact support with ' + err.request_id)
}
```

Devon (sdk): Tests: need a parity suite that asserts the SDK translates HTTP codes+body -> correct typed exception with the expected fields. I can add tests in `sdk/tests/error_parity_test.py` and mirror for JS.

CI Bot: A failing test was reported in `integration/sample-app` — `test_handled_auth_error` (job 4821). Link: https://ci.internal/4821

Sam (platform): FYI, adding `error.hint` to API responses is a breaking change for some old clients that parse raw body. We should version this under `X-Api-Error-Schema: 1` header and the middleware should set it. Backwards compatible if we always include `error.message` at minimum.

Maya (devex): Good call on version header. Action items:
- Devon: prototype typed exceptions + tests (ETA 2d)
- Alex: middleware to normalize non-JSON errors + header (ETA 3d)
- Sam: add `error.hint` to platform responses and coordinate with infra (ETA 4d)
- Maya: update quickstart sample app and docs to show typed handling + UX patterns (ETA 5d)

Devon (sdk): I'll open PRs today for Python + TS with tests. Will ping here when ready for review. :thumbsup:

Alex (eng): I'll put middleware into a feature branch and add an e2e that hits LB to ensure HTML -> JSON normalization.

Maya (devex): Thanks all — this should reduce a ton of onboarding tickets. If anyone sees tricky edge-cases (e.g., streaming errors) call them out now.

Devon (sdk): Streaming note: we should surface an early `onError` event with the typed error (stream may be terminated mid-token). I will add a small RFC for stream error contract.

Sam (platform): Noted. Let's track RFC in GH issue `platform/error-schema`.

Maya (devex): Great, closing thread after PRs merge.
